blurb: Guests learn axe throwing from experienced Axe Masters and compete with friends, coworkers, or family. The facility features 16 axe throwing lanes and hosts events for groups up to 200 guests or full venue buyouts up to 340 guests. Safety orientations and tutorials are provided before play, and the environment is adult-oriented with a minimum age of 16.
